title: Home
description: What needs your attention, what is running and what is planned.

demoAccounts.title: Demo accounts created
demoAccounts.text: Sign in as {{users}} with the password {{password}} to see the roles in action (dana = designer, olivia = operator, adam = approver, audrey = auditor, vera = viewer; olivia and adam form the team “Service Desk”).

getStarted.title: Get started
getStarted.step1: 1. Add a platform (Insights Hub tenant, Industrial Edge Management, any REST API) with its credentials and API spec.
getStarted.step2: 2. Create a process from a template or from scratch.
getStarted.step3: 3. Run it (start with a dry run) or schedule it.

notSetUp.documents: No documents with a review cycle yet

checklist.title: Get started

platform.title: Add a platform
platform.text: An Insights Hub tenant, an Industrial Edge Management or any REST API, with its credentials and API spec.

process.title: Create a process
process.text: Start from a template (health checks, access reviews, inventory) or build your own flow.

run.title: Start a dry run
run.text: A dry run simulates every change and writes the full protocol – nothing is changed on the platform.

schedule.title: Schedule a process
schedule.text: Let health checks and reviews run on their own, e.g. every Monday morning.

monitor.title: Watch a system with a monitor
monitor.text: Composable uptime checks with root causes, maintenance windows and alerts.

credential.title: Document your credentials
credential.text: Where each credential is kept, who owns it and when it expires – never the secret itself.

users.title: Invite your team
users.text: Add users or connect single sign-on; roles decide what everybody may do.

report.title: Send a summary report
report.text: A weekly or monthly PDF for the service meeting: availability, credentials, runs and documents.

checklist.discoverTokens: API tokens for scripts and AI assistants (MCP)

checks.showResolved_one: Show the check that passes again
checks.showResolved_other: Show the {{count}} checks that pass again
